Clockwork_Brass_Glider_Wings.description: Crafted from intricate brass gears and delicate cogs, the Clockwork Brass Glider Wings hum with mechanical life, enhancing the agility and dexterity of their bearer as they ascend into the skies with unparalleled grace and precision.

Gargoyle_Stone_Bat_Wings.description: Enveloped in a cold, petrified stone, the Gargoyle's bat-like wings are a testament to its ancient and unyielding nature, granting it the ability to soar through the night sky with silent, mechanical efficiency and bestowing a natural armor that deters even the most relentless of attacks.

Steam_Powered_Jet_Thrusters.description: Embedded within the skeletal frame of this mechanical marvel are steam-powered jet thrusters, their hissing and roiling steam creating a formidable propulsion system that grants unparalleled aerial speed, though the added bulk and complexity slightly hinder the agility of the construct.

Crystal_Levitation_Prisms.description: Emerging from the back of the construct, these crystalline prisms shimmer with an inner glow, their facets perfectly aligned to manipulate the forces of gravity and magic, allowing the entity to hover and fly with effortless grace while also reflecting harmful spells back to their origin.

Necrotic_Stitched_Leather_Wings.description: These Necrotic Stitched Leather Wings are a macabre marvel of dark craftsmanship, their undead-like flesh fluttering silently as they carry their bearer through the night sky, enhancing their endurance while instilling dread in the hearts of all who witness their shadowed flight.

Living_Wood_Leaf_Canopy_Wings.description: Sprouting from the back of the entity like a dense, verdant forest, the Living Wood Leaf Canopy Wings are a marvel of nature and magic, their countless leaves rustling softly as they enable swift and silent flight while also granting the bearer a semblance of the forest's resilience and agility.

Scrap_Metal_Junk_Wings.description: Creaking and groaning with each flap, the Scrap_Metal_Junk_Wings are a crude amalgamation of twisted scrap metal and crude mechanical joints, granting their owner the ability to fly at the cost of agility, while enhancing their strength and providing them with the skills to sunder and scavenge for more materials.

Mithril_Bladed_Razor_Wings.description: These razor-sharp wings, crafted from the light yet incredibly resilient metal of mithril, grant their bearer unmatched agility in the air, allowing them to soar with unparalleled speed and precision while leaving a trail of bleeding foes in their wake.

Porcelain_Doll_Ornamental_Wings.description: These delicate, ornamental wings are crafted from the finest porcelain, capable of hovering with an ethereal grace that enchants all who gaze upon them. Their doll-like appearance and ceramic composition grant an aura of otherworldly charm, enhancing one's charisma and offering the skills to lure foes and levitate through the air with eerie elegance.

Arcane_Energy_Hardlight_Wings.description: Emerging from the arcane essence of the void, these shimmering wings are crafted from raw magical energy, granting their bearer the ability to soar through the skies with an ethereal glow that can both illuminate and deflect the most potent spells, while enhancing their wisdom and charisma.
